services.name: Bike Like a Star
services.desc: The Museums are closed for the summer months. We hope to see you when we reopen in October. Many Hollywood stars enjoyed traveling around Palm Springs on bicycles. You can cruise the very same neighborhoods with our docent viewing incredible architecture, celebrity homes and stunning scenery. See landmarks of Palm Springs and hear fascinating tales of life in this popular playground. Questions? Please read the Know Before You Go so you can be prepared for your tour.FAQ → Partners:*Bikes provided by Bike Palm Springs under contract to the Palm Springs Historical Society.
